A RESOLUTION ABOLISHING A PRIOR PRACTICE WHEREIN IT ACCEPTED TIRES AT THE TREUTLEN COUNTY RECYCLING CENTER WITHOUT CHARGE, DEFININIG THE TYPES OF TIRES THAT WILL BE ACCEPTED AND SETTING THE FEES BY WHICH TREUTLEN COUNTY SHALL ACCEPT TIRES AT THE TREUTLEN COUNTY RECYCLING CENTER IN THE FUTURE.

On this day, the 1s day of May, 2018, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners have met for the purpose of discussing and passing a Resolution, abolishing a prior practice wherein Treutlen County accepted tires at the Treutlen County Recycling Center without charge, defining what type and size of tires will be accepted and further setting the fees for the acceptance of tires at the Treutlen County Recycling Center in the future.

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners have heard input from the public with regards to its prior practice of accepting tires at the Treutlen County Recycling Center and have further weighed and considered the resulting costs incurred and benefits received by Treutlen County with regards to the continued acceptance of tires at the Treutlen County Recycling Center; and

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners desire to continue a practice by which Treutlen County citizens may deliver tires to the

Treutlen County Recycling Center, upon the payment of a fee, so as to off-set the costs incurred by Treutlen County;

THEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Commissioners, such Resolution was passed.

BE IT RESOLVED, that the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners of Treutlen County, Georgia, shall hereby amend its tire acceptance policy with regards to the operation of the Treutlen County Recycling Center, whereas tires shall be accepted at the Treutlen County Recycling Center in the future, from Treutlen County residents, upon the payment of the following fees:

Automobile & Light Duty Truck tires: $1.50 each Tractor Trailer tires (max. 24.5” diameter): $7.50 each

Only road legal tires will be accepted and no farm tires or large construction equipment tires will be accepted.

This Resolution shall become effective immediately.

This the 1st day of May, 2018.

Board of Corfimissioners

Attest:

Treutlen County Administrator
